distribution.reason: Local Linux + native Windows candidate. Linux lanes and Windows CI evidence retained; whole-image licensing, source delivery admission and digest-bound source companion remain incomplete. No publication authorized.

constraints: Linux amd64 container: source-built server (net10.0, ASP.NET Core runtime 10.0.12, libicu) plus source-built client module; fixed container-loopback HTTP 127.0.0.1:8080 and native TCP 127.0.0.1:8765.
One token per state directory: initialization provisions exactly one labeled slot via the management API and refuses foreign, ambiguous, or partial state without reset.
PIN_FILE/SO_PIN_FILE are preferred; scalar alternatives are explicit disposable-test inputs. Conflicting scalar/file or absent/empty credentials fail initial provisioning.

Every phase starts its own owned server, requires HTTP health plus a native PKCS#11 probe plus the provisioned slot, and stops the server; exec leaves the server as a child of the application so container teardown ends both.
Compatible initialization preserves the existing token and needs no credentials again. Marker, database, and slot/label identity must all agree.
Ordinary application consumers do not require checker, Python, tracing, or a workspace mount. Reset is an explicit removal/replacement of disposable state; no automatic reset or retry.

Native bundles (debian13-amd64 export, windows-amd64 archive or source build) install via the N1 bundle machinery with explicit host/ABI preflight; the host supplies .NET 10 with ASP.NET Core 10.0.12 or later, plus the x64 VC runtime on Windows.
Native runs supervise one owned server on per-instance loopback HTTP/TCP ports, provision one labeled slot per state directory, and never attach to occupied ports or foreign state.
Whole-image licensing, source companion delivery, and digest-bound admission remain separate requirements.
